question:

solution:
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) ने Paytm Payments Bank Limited का बैंकिंग लाइसेंस 24 अप्रैल 2026 से रद्द कर दिया, जो बैंकिंग विनियमन अधिनियम, 1949 की धारा 22(4) के तहत लिया गया निर्णय है। यह कार्रवाई KYC उल्लंघन, कमजोर कॉर्पोरेट गवर्नेंस और जमाकर्ताओं के धन की सुरक्षा से जुड़े जोखिमों के कारण की गई। इसके बाद बैंक सभी बैंकिंग सेवाएँ बंद करेगा और उसके परिसमापन की प्रक्रिया शुरू हो सकती है।
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has cancelled the banking license of Paytm Payments Bank Limited, effective April 24, 2026; this decision was taken under Section 22(4) of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949. Consequently, the bank will cease all banking operations, and the process for its liquidation may commence.

Explanation – India's highest waterfall, Kunchikal (455 m high), is located on the Varahi River in Karnataka state, while Jog Waterfall is located on the Sharavati River in Karnataka (253 m high). It is also called Mahatma Gandhi or Jog or Garsoppa Falls. question:

solution:

Explanation: The Nathu La Pass is situated on the India-China border in the state of Sikkim. Located at an elevation of approximately 4,310 meters above sea level, this pass constitutes a branch of the ancient Silk Route. Nathu La is also one of the trade routes operating across the India-China border. Following the India-China War (1962), it was reopened for the first time in the year 2006.

question:
Spherical shape of raindrop is due to:

solution:

Rain drops are spherical due to surface tension. The unit of surface tension is Newton/meter. It is noteworthy that surface tension decreases as temperature increases. Surface tension becomes zero at critical temperature.

question:
Mammoth is the ancestor of–

solution:

Explanation: Mammoth was a giant elephant-like creature which is now extinct. Its scientific name is ‘Mammuthus primigenius’. This is the name of an elephant buried in snow in the tundra region of Siberia, which is now extinct. But due to snow, his entire dead body was found safe even today. It is estimated that this animal would have survived in France until the end of the Ice Age and possibly even longer in Siberia.

question:
Which one of the following is used as a moderator in the nuclear reactor? 
नाभिकीय रिएक्टर में निम्नलिखित में से किसे मंदक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है?
solution:
व्याख्या : नाभिकीय रिएक्टरों में मंदक के रूप में ग्रेफाइट और भारी जल (D2O) का प्रयोग किया जाता है। जब ग्रेफाइट का उपयोग मंदक के रूप में होता है तो रिएक्टर को परमाणु पाइल (Atomic Pile) कहते हैं किंतु भारी जल का मंदक के रूप में प्रयोग होने पर वह स्वीमिंग पूल रिएक्टर कहलाता है।
Explanation: Graphite and heavy water (D2O) are used as moderator in nuclear reactors. When graphite is used as a moderator, the reactor is called Atomic Pile, but when heavy water is used as a moderator, it is called a swimming pool reactor.

question:
Consider the following statements concerning the human body:1. The bile duct releases its contents into the stomach.2. The pancreatic duct releases its contents into the duodenum.Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
मानव शरीर से सम्बन्धित निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए : 1. पित्तवाहिनी, आमाशय में अपनी अंतर्वस्तुएँ मोचित करती है। 2. अग्न्याशय वाहिनी, ग्रहणी (ड्ओडिनम) में अपनी अंतर्वस्तुएँ मोचित करती है। उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
options: Neither 1 nor 2 / न ही 1 तथा न ही 2
solution:
व्याख्या : पित्तवाहिनी आमाशय में अपनी अंतर्वस्तुएं मोचित नहीं करती हैं। यकृत से पित्त बनकर पित्ताशय में आकर संचित रहता है। यहां से पित्तवाहिनी द्वारा ग्रहणी (जो छोटी आँत का ऊपरी भाग) में आ जाता है। यहीं से यह छोटी आंत में आता है। पित्त में कोई एन्जाइम नहीं होता किन्तु इसमें उपस्थित अकार्बनिक लवण आमाशय में आये भोजन को क्षारीय कर देता है जिससे पाचन में सहायता मिलती है।
Explanation: The bile duct does not release its contents into the stomach. Bile is formed from the liver and stored in the gallbladder. From here it enters the duodenum (which is the upper part of the small intestine) via the bile duct. This is where it comes from in the small intestine. Bile does not contain any enzymes but the inorganic salts present in it alkalize the food in the stomach which helps in digestion.

Its exact opposite is diastolic pressure which arises as a result of diastole of the ventricles. When blood is entering the ventricle from the auricle. question:

question: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.He said to his brother, "Pack your bags and leave now."
options: He instructed his brother to pack his bags and leave then
He told his brother that pack your bags and leave now
He ordered his brother to pack your bags and leave now
He suggested his brother that he should pack his bags and leave then
solution:
उपरोक्त reported speech का वाक्य V1 (pack) स प्रारम्भ हुआ है अतः यह imperative sentence है इसका indirect निम्न नियम से बनेगा।
(i) reporting verb 'said' का वाक्य के भाव के अनुसार instructed में परिवर्तित करेंगे।
(ii) comma, inverted comma के स्थान पर 'to' का प्रयोग conjunction के रूप में करेंगे। 
(iii) narration rule के अनुसार pronoun आदि में परिवर्तन www करंग।
(iv) now का then में परिवर्तित करेंगे।
Correct indirect sentence- He instructed his brother to pack his bags and leave then.
The sentence of the above reported speech starts with V1 (pack), hence it is an imperative sentence, its indirect sentence will be formed by the following rule.(i) The reporting verb 'said' will be changed to instructed as per the sense of the sentence.(ii) In place of comma, inverted comma, 'to' will be used as a conjunction.(iii) The pronoun etc. will be changed as per the narration rule.(iv) Now will be changed to then.Correct indirect sentence- He instructed his brother to pack his bags and leave then.

question:
For what purpose was the work of laying the railway line till Farukhnagar done?
फारुखनगर तक रेलवे लाइन बिछाने का कार्य किस उद्देश्य से किया गया था?
options: For the purpose of military transfer / सैनिक स्थानान्तरण के उद्देश्य से
to carry salt / नमक ढोने के लिए
to carry stones / पत्थर ढोने के लिए
To establish bicycle industry / साइकिल उद्योग की स्थापना के लिए
solution: फारुखनगर तक रेलवे लाइन बिछाने का कार्य नमक ढ़ोने के लिए किया गया था। आजादी से पहले फारुखनगर से काफी मात्रा में नमक का व्यापार होता था। व्यापार को बढ़ावा देने के लिए अंग्रेजी हुकूमत ने 1901 में इस रेलवे लाइन को बनाकर फारुखनगर तक रेल सेवा शुरू की थी। इस रेलवे लाइन की लम्बाई मात्र 12 किमी. है।The work of laying the railway line to Farukhnagar was done to transport salt. Before independence, a large amount of salt was traded from Farukhnagar. To promote trade, the British government built this railway line in 1901 and started rail service to Farukhnagar. The length of this railway line is only 12 km.

question:
In which year was the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) scheme launched in Haryana?
हरियाणा में किस वर्ष प्रत्यक्ष लाभ अंतरण (DBT) योजना का शुभारंभ हुआ ?
solution: हरियाणा में वर्ष 2013 में प्रत्यक्ष लाभ अंतरण (DBT) योजना का शुभारम्भ हुआ था। राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा अधिनियम (2013) द्वारा लक्षित सार्वजनिक वितरण प्रणाली में सुधार लाने के लिए खाद्य पात्रता प्रदान करने के लिए नकद अंतरण जैसी स्क्रीमों सहित प्रदान की जाती है।The Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) scheme was launched in Haryana in 2013. The National Food Security Act (2013) aims to improve the Targeted Public Distribution System by providing food entitlements along with schemes like cash transfers.

question:
In which district of Haryana is the tourist place named Tiliyar located?
तिलियर नामक पर्यटक स्थल हरियाणा के किस जिले में स्थित है?
